newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA OTC STOCKS INCHES DOWN IN IDLLE TRADING.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA OTC STOCKS INCHES DOWN IN IDLLE TRADING.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market went down on Monday as investors continued to stay on the sidelines due to the summer break, traders said.
They said the slip was in no way connected to falls on major world markets.
"Our OTC market is not linked with foreign stocks," said a trader. "Today's slide is a feature of the holiday mood."
Brokers expected the market to remain almost unchanged in the coming days, with minor developments forecast.
Three independent market indices lost some ground due to most of the blue chips, which closed flat or marginally lower.
The VAB-RA all-share index went down 1.2 percent to 6,167.2 points and the BIG-OTC shed 0.79 percent to 4,453.45. The CAS-RQ lost 0.5 percent to close at 984 points.
On Monday 220 stocks ended lower, 155 higher and prices of 279 companies were flat.
Cement maker Romcim lost 2,000 lei closing at 115,000 in late trading.
State-run oil refineries Petromidia and Petrobrazi ended flat on Friday's close of 42,500 lei and 45,500 respectively. Steel mill Sidex also finished unchanged at 23,500.
Arpechim, another refinery firmed 1,000 lei to 40,000, in late trading.
